target_customer: Parents of children with ADHD and behavior disorders paying subscriptions, with clinicians as a channel
problem: Parents struggle to get kids with ADHD and related disorders to build daily routines. Joon gamifies real-life tasks that parents assign and kids complete.
business_model: Consumer subscription app (reported 89.99 dollars per year), moving toward clinician-integrated digital therapeutic
product_category: Pediatric digital health, gamified behavior app

founders.name: Isaac Eaves
founders.background_notes: Sources say the three founders met at UC Berkeley.

founders.name: Brad Brenner
founders.background_notes: One source says he started his first business at age 7.

competitors.name: Akili Interactive (EndeavorRx)
competitors.what: Prescription video game treatment for children with ADHD, FDA De Novo cleared June 2020
competitors.traction_then: Announced commercial launch in second half of 2022

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile game with parent controls is standard consumer app engineering; clinical validation is the hard part and was not yet shown.

defensibility.rationale: Content and habit loops are copyable; FDA clearance or clinical evidence would be the moat but none was found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Akili had the only cleared product, but it was not a chore-routine tool. No reported copying found.

market_need_then: ADHD and behavior disorders affect large numbers of US children and prescription digital therapeutics had just been cleared by FDA, creating interest. No hard spend data found.

branding.domain_note: Uses joonhealth.co; the .com not found as theirs.

brand_strength.rationale: Little press about the brand itself. The short name is also shared by other companies, including a Seattle company named Joon that raised 6M, which causes confusion in aggregators.

outcome_analysis: Joon is still early stage, with about 10 staff and a reported 6.4 million dollar seed in 2023. It sells a quest-based routine app rather than a cleared therapeutic, and no outcome events are reported. Evidence of product market fit is not public, so it cannot yet be judged as a success or a stall.
notes: Seed date differs: August 2023 (YC announcement per summary) versus October 2023 (Seedtable) versus July 2023 (another profile with different investors). Another profile reports a separate 2.1M seed in Oct 2022, unverified. A CB Insights total of 9.81M appears tied to a different company and is ignored. Geekwire's 6M Joon story is a different Seattle company. No SEC Form D checked. Founder backgrounds thin. Company website not fetched.
